pr.title: Keep a head's UNREVIEWED key while review.automatic is false
pr.head: 9469c41a6d5067c29c258b0273db7c58669cd81e

summary: The watch daemon is the one process per machine that polls the pull requests agent sessions work on and sends each session events. One of those events, UNREVIEWED, tells the session fixing a pull request that its head is ready for review and that nothing will review it. The daemon sends it once per head. It remembers each head it announced by a key, unreviewed:<number>:<head>, in the fixer's state, and a head whose key is still there is not announced again.

Each pass, the daemon either keeps or drops that key. It drops the key when the head no longer needs a review at all: the pull request became a draft or the head was signed off. It keeps the key when the head still needs a review but something else will give it one, such as a live start comment or review.ci. The repository setting review.automatic = false, which means its pull requests get a review only when someone asks, belongs with the second kind, and the code comment already said so. But the check sat with the first kind, so turning the setting off and back on announced a head the fixer had already heard about.
This pull request moves the check to the kept-key branch, adds a test that turns the setting off and on, and rewords the UNREVIEWED row in docs/cli.md.

groups.title: Holding a head back keeps its key
groups.kicker: Where route_fix checks review.automatic, and the test that pins it
intro: Pass.route_fix works out what the fixer of one pull request should hear on this pass. For UNREVIEWED it has two nested conditions:

1. The outer condition asks whether the head needs a review at all: not a draft, no review requested of named reviewers, and not signed off. When it fails, the key is not carried into kept, so it is dropped.
  2. The inner condition asks whether something else will review the head: a live start comment from an account whose review counts, a session on another machine, or GitHub Actions under review.ci. When it holds, the key is carried over if the head was already announced. Otherwise the daemon announces the head.

The change moves not self.settings_of(repo).automatic from the outer condition to the front of the inner one. A head never announced is still not announced while the setting is false, because the kept-key branch copies only keys already in announced.

files.note: route_fix: the review.automatic check moves into the hold-back condition.

checks.text: not automatic short-circuits before counted_reviews, reviewed_remotely, and reviewed_in_ci, which skips no side effect: settings_of caches per pass, and the other two only read state. live_starts still runs before it, but it only reads the pull request's comments. Checked by reading each function.

groups.title: The UNREVIEWED row in the CLI reference
groups.kicker: Rewording what a repository with no .projector.toml gets
intro: The UNREVIEWED row of the watch events table in docs/cli.md lists three settings the daemon reads: review.ci, review.automatic, and review.reviewers. It said a repository committing no .projector.toml "has neither setting". The new wording says such a repository sets none of these settings itself, so only your ~/.projector.toml applies, and review.automatic stays true unless that file sets it.

files.note: One sentence of the UNREVIEWED row changes.

checks.text: The sentence agrees with committed_settings, which calls config.load_committed(None, "") for a repository with no .projector.toml and so still layers ~/.projector.toml. Checked by reading the code; the author reproduced it with HOME pointing at a file that sets automatic = false.
